title: Reprocessable carbon fiber composites via disulfide-exchange epoxy vitrimers: experimental and molecular simulation insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17480-17496
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00851H, Paper
Open Access

Harsh Sharma, Nehal Kaushik, Songchang Liu, Rajkamal Anand, Nanda Gopal Sahoo, Gun Jin Yun, Sravendra Rana
Carbon fiber-reinforced vitrimer composites containing dynamic bonds exhibit excellent self-healing and recyclability behavior. MD simulations were employed to gain atomic-level insights into elastic and viscoelastic behavior of vitrimer matrix..
